notes: Batch 28 CLOSED 2026-09-29. Full narrative in docs/journey-runs/BATCH_28_RESULTS.md. Executed strictly batch-by-batch per explicit user instruction: Batch 29 has NOT been started and must not begin until the user reviews this closure. Key process notes for future batches: (1) the browser automation tool has a recurring quirk where read_page/computer report a stale '0x0' viewport after a tab has navigated/logged-in multiple times; the reliable workaround is opening a genuinely fresh tab via tabs_create + navigate immediately before any click-requiring interaction, confirmed repeatedly throughout this batch. (2) Switching test personas requires a real logout+login (shared cookie jar), not just opening a new tab; several mis-clicks this batch happened when a 'logged out' assumption was wrong because /login silently redirected an already-authenticated session back to /my-work instead of showing the login form. (3) Direct RPC calls via the Supabase execute_sql tool (service-role, bypassing the app's own permission/Server-Action layer) were used deliberately for V-044's and V-045's stress/idempotency variants, exactly as those journeys' own canonical text calls for ('Attempt via direct RPC call bypassing the UI entirely'); this is distinct from, and does not substitute for, the real-UI evidence still captured for the Regular Path of every journey with a user-visible assertion. (4) A commercial-configuration draft only allows one in-progress draft per config at a time; 'Create New Version' silently reopens the existing draft rather than erroring, which is why V-041 and V-042 ended up sharing one draft record. All test-only fixture state (persona sessions, temporary go-live customer-confirmation flag set via set_go_live_customer_confirmation as fixture setup for W-006) reflects genuine, intentional test data in this environment; no cleanup of shared fixtures was required since none were left in an inconsistent state. Do not start Batch 29 until the user reviews this closure.
